newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: BWT top Vienna gainer, hits all-time high.
newsitem.headline: BWT top Vienna gainer, hits all-time high.

text.p: Shares in BWT, the Austrian maker of water-treatment technology, surged to an all-time high in Vienna on Monday on follow-through demand after the shares broke through heavy resistance last week, traders said.
At 0946 GMT, BWT was up 3.55 percent, or 65 schillings, at 1,894, making it the top gainer in Vienna. The shares initially climbed up to 1,900 schillings.
Since the beginning of the year, BWT has soared almost 70 percent, while the all-share Vienna bourse index has gained 11.5 percent.
The all-time closing high for BWT shares is 1,850 schillings, hit in 1994. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
